text:
Some properties of a plastic pollutant are listed.
1
It is a poor conductor of electricity.
2
It does not react with water.
3
It is resistant to oxidation.
4
It has low density.
Which properties explain why this plastic is difficult to remove from the environment?
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Chemistry
